display.purpose: Confident native-sans hero; maximum 88px on the homepage.

headline.purpose: Major product and narrative sections; 600 weight and tight balanced lines.

title.purpose: Project names, service names, and supporting panel titles.

body.purpose: Readable project explanations, generally 16–18px within a restrained text measure.

label.purpose: Compact navigation, source notes, facts, and controls.

shadows.name: phone-hero
shadows.purpose: Depth below the homepage product devices.

shadows.name: phone-supporting
shadows.purpose: Soft separation around actual interface captures.

shadows.name: selected-tab
shadows.purpose: Active white segment above a silver control track.

shadows.name: navigation-divider
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation beneath the translucent header.

shadows.name: package-device
shadows.purpose: Local depth around the actual interface inside the dark package stage.

shadows.name: package-chip
shadows.purpose: Lift hosting and publishing chips on desktop; omitted on mobile.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Shared CSS product and interaction easing.

motion.name: entrance-ease
motion.purpose: GSAP hero entrance easing.

motion.name: hero-copy
motion.purpose: Already-visible headline and supporting copy move into place.

motion.name: hero-devices
motion.value: Inner center .apple-desktop: 1.7s starting at .12s; inner phones: 1.6s starting at .25s and .33s
motion.purpose: Entrance transforms act on the inner desktop and phones, independently of the outer wrappers used by the scroll fan.

motion.name: chapter-copy
motion.purpose: Transition into a selected product chapter.

motion.name: chapter-visual
motion.purpose: Product imagery accompanies the selected chapter.

motion.name: mobile-navigation
motion.purpose: Native menu entrance.

motion.name: scroll-scrub
motion.purpose: Subtle GSAP product separation and contextual-image parallax.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Keep every control and content item accessible without the authored motion.

motion.name: sticky-eligibility
motion.purpose: Use scroll-selected product chapters only when the complete stage fits comfortably.

motion.name: reduced-transparency
motion.purpose: Replace translucent navigation with an opaque white surface.

motion.name: hero-scroll-fan
motion.purpose: Fan the outer hero wrappers without overwriting the inner device entrance transforms.

motion.name: hero-fan-eligibility
motion.purpose: Enable the hero scroll fan on layouts with a fine pointer and hover.

motion.name: package-eligibility
motion.purpose: Enable package scroll choreography and pointer tilt; separate from sticky chapter eligibility.

motion.name: package-entrance-ease
motion.purpose: Ease the package device, numerals and support chips into their scroll-linked positions.

motion.name: package-screen-crossfade
motion.purpose: Switch the actual Build, Launch and Care interface captures.

motion.name: package-panel
motion.purpose: Bring in the selected chapter explanation when motion is enabled.

motion.name: package-pointer
motion.value: Approximately ±2.5deg on each axis; .55s transform smoothing
motion.purpose: Add device tilt for fine pointers, resetting on pointer leave or eligibility changes; touch and reduced motion bypass it.

motion.name: package-composition-scrub
motion.purpose: Scroll-linked arrival of the package device, payment/care numerals and support chips.

motion.name: package-orbit-scrub
motion.purpose: Move local orbital geometry through 16 degrees and −30px as the package passes the viewport.

narrative.northStar: The work has to work. A distinctive editorial software studio portfolio with real product proof.
narrative.overview: The 9 October 2026 FIELDWORK art direction supersedes the 8 October Apple style on converted pages. Preserve case provenance and the existing product data. Unconverted routes retain prior styles until separately reviewed.
keyCharacteristics: Large native sans-serif type, with a locally hosted Geist fallback.
Real software presented at a readable scale.
One neutral visual system across home, archive, detail pages, forms, viewer, and footer, with a local dark stage for the project package.
Purposeful product choreography and optional, manually controlled recordings.

rules.name: The Neutral Frame Rule
rules.body: Product colors belong to actual imagery and selected presentation stages. They do not establish separate site identities.

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Headings and prose use the same sans family. Do not reintroduce the previous serif pairing, uppercase technical labels, or gradient-filled type. Keep ordinary text tracking at or above −0.04em; reserve the tighter package tracking for its heading and oversized numerals.

rules.name: The Product Depth Rule
rules.body: Spend depth on the presented software and active overlays. Keep text sections, facts, and routine cards calm.

dos: Do keep KashCrop’s logo and factual project records intact.
Do build new pages in the same neutral material and sans-serif hierarchy.
Do use actual interfaces, original copy, clear destinations, and honest recording provenance.
Do make product motion ambitious while keeping the complete static experience available.
Do inspect mobile spacing, focus, long-screen scrolling, and real content together.
donts: Don't restore the superseded Fraunces/red-room presentation or layer another design identity over this one.
Don't substitute fabricated application screenshots, adoption figures, or validation claims.
Don't turn every section into an animation demo or conceal content until scrolling triggers it.
Don't autoplay optional recordings or leave a hidden recording playing after its disclosure closes.
Don't discard useful project details, source notes, URL behavior, or gallery access while simplifying the layout.
